name: Saint-Lary-Soulan
description: Saint-Lary was created in 1957 as the first purpose-built ski resort in the Pyrenees. The ski area covers 100km across 3 sectors: Pla d'Adet (1,700m, main base), Espiaube (high altitude, 2,230m), and Vallon du Portet. Altitude range 1,650-2,515m. Linked to the village by two lifts — a téléphérique and a télécabine. Snowpark and freeride zones. Sensoria thermal spa for wellness. Espiaube cable car operates in summer for hiking access to Col du Portet and Bastan refuge lakes. Bike park. Hiking trails, Patou trail for children. 20+ hamlets across the commune.

overview.atmosphere: One of the largest ski areas in the Pyrenees (100km). 3 sectors: Pla d'Adet (1,700m), Espiaube, Vallon du Portet. First Pyrenean resort (created 1957). Thermal spa (Sensoria). Bike park. Col du Portet access.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowpark, freeride zones, snowshoeing, ski touring, guided walks, heritage discovery of Soulan valley. Thermal baths in village.

honest_drawbacks: Lower village altitude (830m) — needs lifts to reach ski area
